title: xyzEngine
description: A new gen Modpack wich enchances your Minecraft experience
body:
# xyzEngine

xyzEngine is a **client-side** enhancement modpack designed to refine and elevate the vanilla Minecraft experience. Developed and updated over the course of two years, this pack focuses on performance optimizations, interface improvements, and subtle visual upgrades — all while preserving the core gameplay that makes Minecraft unique.

Because xyzEngine is entirely client-side, it is fully compatible with any world or server without requiring others to install it. The goal is to provide a smoother, more immersive experience that feels natural and intuitive, whether you’re exploring, building, or adventuring.

With xyzEngine, Minecraft runs cleaner, looks sharper, and plays more seamlessly — delivering an upgraded experience without compromising the original spirit of the game.

![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/93953873cd9e4433c6c6e7ea634f70c88c784cab.png)
- Optimazed Minecraft Rendering Engine With The Use Of Sodium and bobby
- Shaders Supported With Iris Mod
- Better f3 Mod for better f3 Menu
- Carpet Mod for singleplayer
